materialModel: Unity built-in Standard painted reinforced-concrete dielectric with physically scaled UV0 and two independent neutral coating-frequency fields

finishLayers: matte exterior protective coating with aggregate and application/chalking variation
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: openings, returns, drips, joints, slab lips and penetrations remain geometry; aggregate, coating grain and low-amplitude finish variation remain material response
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.mountingAndInterfaces: facade coating terminates at aluminum sash/seal, balcony slab/drip and construction-joint geometry; the anti-repeat layer does not invent geometric seams
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.exposureAndAging: anti-repeat detail represents non-directional coating/application/chalking variation only. Rain runoff, sill streaks, splash and metal-source staining remain cause-based overlays with separate metadata.
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.orientation: detail albedo follows the existing Danchi-local physically scaled UV0 projection; no camera- or sun-facing projection is allowed

physicalScale.reasoning: 2.4 m and 7.9 m resolve to 2400 mm and 7900 mm; LCM is 189600 mm. The combined material therefore cannot return to the exact same two-layer macro phase within the 26 m hero facade.

detailAlbedoGeneration.modulationIntent: very low-amplitude neutral luminance modulation; preserve base painted-RC hue and PBR roughness/normal response
detailAlbedoGeneration.tileability: integer-frequency mixed-direction sinusoidal field; exact edge-periodic texture

angularResponse.front: neutral coating variation is subordinate to diffuse material color; no repeated dark/light panel stamp
angularResponse.oblique: normal/roughness structure remains dominant while the low-frequency albedo field prevents exact macro recurrence
angularResponse.grazing: dielectric Fresnel and real geometry create highlights; anti-repeat albedo must not create a highlight stripe

automaticFailConditions: formal facade has no dedicated anti-repeat detail albedo
anti-repeat texture is replaced by the same texture as primary albedo
detail UV scale no longer represents 7.9 m on the 2.4 m physical UV field
combined exact macro repeat falls below 100 m
detail maps switch away from formal physical UV0
detail albedo becomes emissive, metallic, directional, or encodes a baked highlight/shadow
source-side anti-repeat QA is used to clear the rendered repeated-pattern critical defect without native 4K/temporal evidence

failureInjection: remove _DetailAlbedoMap and require formal capture pre-cull to fail
bind the primary facade albedo as _DetailAlbedoMap and require fail
change detail scale to 1.0 (2.4 m, commensurate with the primary field) and require fail
change detail UV set to UV1 and require fail
disable mipmaps or anisotropy and require fail
enable emission on the formal facade material and require fail

renderReview.temporalEvidence: inspect the oblique/grazing camera movement for texture swimming, moire or an anti-repeat layer that becomes perceptible as its own pattern
inspection: no exact 2.4 m macro patch recurrence is immediately legible across the 26 m apartment facade
coating remains neutral and matte rather than cloudy, striped or spotlighted
sash, balcony and runoff interfaces remain cause-based and are not blurred by the anti-repeat layer
100% crop retains aggregate/micro-normal detail and stable mip behavior
grazing highlights follow geometry, sun and Fresnel rather than the detail-albedo field
